_comment: Rows for /pokemon-booster-box-prices (Deal Hunter, Goal League S1, Nov 3 2026 PT). Every price is our dated SOLD mark: the median of the completed eBay sales (eBay rows only; other marketplaces' rows dropped) PriceCharting lists for that exact sealed product, last 30 days (the page shows the most recent sales, so a liquid product's window is often a week; from/asOf = first and last sale counted). Multi-unit lots, blisters, damaged or torn wrap, half boxes ("18 packs"), graded copies and opened product are dropped by title. Re-read 2026-11-13 UTC (Nov 12 evening PT). A sale also has to name its own set in the title and no other set, and damaged-wrap, combo and two-product titles are dropped: on Nov 8 every eBay row on the Mega Evolution booster box page was a Delta Reign, Pitch Black or Japanese box, so that row is out (the Nov 6 read had it at $224.99, which was mostly other sets' boxes). Delta Reign rows added from release-day-on sales (Nov 6–8). The 12.5% chart check now only sends a page to a title read: Chaos Rising ETB ($71.00, about 18% over the page's chart on Nov 8) passed the title read and stays. Left out on purpose: products whose PriceCharting page looks mixed with Pokémon Center or other variants (Scarlet & Violet 151 ETB and bundle, Crown Zenith ETB and bundle, Ascended Heroes ETB), and rows whose 30-day median sits more than 12.5% off the page's own weekly chart value (Prismatic Evolutions bundle, Mega Evolution bundle, 30th Celebration ETB and bundle). Only sets we index. Pack counts and MSRP: Pokémon KB 02 §4 (HIGH). eBay is a search link only, never a mark. Edit here, then run: node tools/build-sealed-prices.mjs. Never hand-edit the SEALED or SEALEDLD blocks. Nov 10 PT: Pokémon Center Elite Trainer Boxes get their own table (11 packs, $59.99 at Pokémon Center, KB 02 §4 HIGH; Surging Sparks left out of this table: the KB pack count covers 2025–26 Pokémon Center ETBs only): their PriceCharting page is the PC edition, and a sale counts only if its title says Pokémon Center (or PC/PKC) and names the set. Pokémon Center editions stay out of the regular ETB table.
